Alice Technologies and Bouygues Travaux Publics have announced a new partnership that will see them collaborate on multiple complex projects across the world using the power of artificial intelligence (AI).

“Our Innovation and PMO department works continuously to identify technologies that enhance our team’s productivity and add value for our clients. The partnership with ALICE Technologies has become a key pillar in keeping AFRY at the technological forefront of project implementation.”

“Our job at ECS isn't just to hand clients a schedule, it's to give them confidence that the plan is the optimized one, not just the first one that worked. ALICE lets us do that. We can show up to client conversations with alternatives ready, not excuses for delays. That's the standard we want across every complex programme we undertake at ECS: sound, evidence-based, and adaptable, because on complex projects, conditions always change.”
